client-preference.description: A specific preference or requirement a client has expressed, worth remembering for future work with them.

campaign-learning.description: Something learned about what worked or didn't in a campaign, worth applying to future ones.

positioning-decision.description: A decision about how the business positions itself, a product, or an offer.

resource-location.description: Where a business folder or file lives (invoices, contracts, brand assets, raw footage, etc.), so future work can find it without asking again.
